title: Grateful Dead Live at Onondaga County War Memorial on 1973-09-17

ai_review.summary: Pitch‑off, very slow recording despite decent sound quality; reviewers note no standout musical moments.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers point out that the tape runs at the wrong speed, making the entire concert sound sluggish and out of pitch. Apart from this major flaw the audio is described as otherwise clear, but there are no specific performance highlights mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: The show receives little to no musical praise and suffers from a serious pitch/speed issue; however the underlying sound quality is noted as decent, yielding an overall below‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape runs too slow – pitch is way off, making everything sound sluggish. Otherwise the mix is clear with no major noise or dropouts mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No comments on song flow or set structure; reviewers focus solely on the speed/pitch problem.
